templates.prompt_template: In a state statistical survey by MoSPI, the retail price of rice in the base period was ₹{base_price} per kg, and in the current period it rose to ₹{current_price} per kg. Calculate the price relative of rice for the current period.
templates.explanation_template: The price relative R is calculated as (Current Price / Base Price) × 100 = ({current_price} / {base_price}) × 100 = {answer:.2f}%.

templates.prompt_template: An official market price report records the price of Mustard Oil as ₹{base_price} in the base year (2020) and ₹{current_price} in the current year. What is the price relative?

distractor_rules.description: Simple average of price relatives without weights
Assigned highest weight to lowest relative

templates.prompt_template: The All-India Consumer Price Index (Base 2012=100) was {prev_cpi} in March 2023 and stood at {curr_cpi} in March 2024. Calculate the annual rate of inflation (percentage change in CPI) for March 2024.

Consider an official MoSPI commodity basket with two major items. Base period prices are p0=[{p0_a}, {p0_b}], base quantities are q0=[{q0_a}, {q0_b}], and current period prices are p1=[{p1_a}, {p1_b}]. What is the Laspeyres Price Index?

distractor_rules.description: Base expenditure divided by current expenditure
Averaged price change without base quantities

templates.explanation_template: Laspeyres Index I_L = (Σ(p1 × q0) / Σ(p0 × q0)) × 100 = {answer:.2f}.

templates.prompt_template: An econometric index calculation for agricultural commodities yields a Laspeyres price index of {laspeyres} and a Paasche price index of {paasche}. Calculate Fisher's Ideal Index.

distractor_rules.description: Calculated (I_L + I_P) / 2 instead of sqrt(I_L * I_P)
Took difference instead of product root
Selected Laspeyres value assuming upper bound

templates.explanation_template: Fisher's Ideal Index = sqrt(I_L × I_P) = sqrt({laspeyres} × {paasche}) = {answer:.2f}.

templates.prompt_template: A statistical investigator's monthly nominal compensation in 2024 was ₹{nominal_wage}. If the applicable Consumer Price Index (Base 2016=100) in 2024 is {cpi_index}, what is the real wage at base year prices? (Round to nearest integer).
Examine the 4-year CPI trajectory chart for the state statistical division. In which year was the largest annual jump (index increase) in CPI recorded?

distractor_rules.description: Selected highest index year rather than highest change

templates.explanation_template: Comparing the annual changes: 2021 increase = {diff_2021:.1f}, 2022 increase = {diff_2022:.1f}, 2023 increase = {diff_2023:.1f}. The largest annual increase was recorded in {answer}.

templates.prompt_template: The bar graph shows each commodity group's weighted contribution to the CPI. Which group contributes the largest number of index points to the aggregate CPI?
templates.explanation_template: Compare the weighted contributions shown in the bar graph: Food = {food_contribution:.2f}, Housing = {housing_contribution:.2f}, Fuel & Light = {fuel_contribution:.2f}. The largest contribution is {answer}.
